  89 50 4e 47 0d 0a 1a 0a
         The PNG signature (\x89 "PNG" CR LF SUB LF). Chosen as the negative
         case because it shares the "binary magic with a CRLF canary" shape
         with the JPEG XL container signature without matching it.
  00 00 00 0d 49 48 44 52
         An IHDR chunk header (length 13, type "IHDR") with no chunk body.
         Filler only -- this is not a valid PNG either.
